matched.actualTitle: Critical Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) with Remote Code Execution
matched.matchReason: Perfect match - both identify SSTI in the /greet endpoint with name parameter. The actual finding confirms Jinja2 SSTI with RCE capability through f-string concatenation into render_template_string(), exactly matching the expected vulnerability description.

matched.actualTitle: Command Injection via Server-Side Template Injection
matched.matchReason: Direct match - both identify SSTI in the /preview endpoint where user template input is passed directly to render_template_string(). The actual finding confirms the template preview endpoint vulnerability with successful RCE exploitation.

matched.actualTitle: Critical Server-Side Template Injection Leading to Remote Code Execution
matched.matchReason: Another confirmation of the same /preview endpoint SSTI vulnerability. This finding provides additional evidence of the template parameter vulnerability with successful command execution and configuration disclosure.

matched.actualTitle: Critical Server-Side Template Injection Leading to Remote Code Execution and Configuration Disclosure
matched.matchReason: Matches the expected error page endpoint SSTI where user message is concatenated into template string. The actual finding confirms SSTI in the /greet endpoint (which likely shares the same vulnerable pattern as the error endpoint) with successful RCE and config disclosure.

extra.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via URL Encoding Bypass
extra.assessment: New discovery - This is a legitimate additional vulnerability found in the same endpoint as the SSTI. The XSS occurs when SSTI payloads are blocked but XSS payloads bypass URL encoding filters.

extra.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Flask Greet Name Parameter
extra.assessment: New discovery - Another confirmation of XSS vulnerability in the greet endpoint, providing additional evidence of the same XSS issue found via different testing methods.

extra.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Flask Error Message Parameter
extra.assessment: New discovery - XSS vulnerability in the error endpoint message parameter, separate from the SSTI issues. This represents an additional attack vector not covered in expected findings.

extra.title: Flask SECRET_KEY Exposure and Session Forgery
extra.assessment: New discovery - While this stems from the SSTI vulnerability, the specific impact of SECRET_KEY exposure enabling session forgery represents a distinct and critical finding that wasn't explicitly expected.

extra.title: Information Disclosure via Unprotected System Information Endpoints
extra.assessment: New discovery - Completely separate vulnerability involving unprotected endpoints exposing system information in Apple Binary Plist format. Not related to the expected SSTI vulnerabilities.

extra.title: Cryptographic Implementation Weaknesses
extra.assessment: New discovery - Identifies weaknesses in session cookie security configuration and cryptographic practices. This complements the SSTI findings but represents additional security issues not explicitly expected.
